csv_project_name: DB for Skyway Fishing Pier Modif-Timber Fishing Piers
csv_scope_of_work: The Florida Department of Transportation (Department) has issued this Request for Proposal (RFP) to solicit competitive Bids and Proposals from Bidders for the construction of four timber fishing piers and associated improvements in Manatee County, FL. The intent of this Low Bid Design-Build project is to construct four new timber fishing piers along the existing South Skyway Fishing Pier Access Road located near the south end of the Sunshine Skyway Bridge in Manatee County, FL. Additional improvements will include construction of sidewalk, accessible parking pads, accessible ramps, and protective bollards as well as installation of signing and pavement markings.
